messages:
erin.mkt: Quick idea  run a concise PLG experiment tied to launch posts + webinar. Goal: lift first-prompt within 48h by ~8% using $15 credits, 3 micro prompt templates, and an inbound routing tweak. Thoughts?

jasper.growth: +1. Propose 3 arms: control, credits-only, credits+templates+in-app nudge. Randomize at signup, N~600/arm.

alexa.content: Two social variants: Variant A = 'Starter prompts + $15 to ship an LLM feature fast.' Variant B = 'Benchmark teaser: similar latency, ~25% token savings. Try with $15.' I'll make 1 hero gif each.

mike.ops: Routing plan: tag webinar signups with trait:launchpad_seed and enqueue grant. Pseudocode: if (signup.campaign=='launchpad') identify(user,{launchpad_seed:true}); grants.enqueue(user,15). Soft cohort cap 40k tokens/day; alert at 65%.

noor.rs: Eval set: 3 prompts (meeting->tasks, short marketing blurb, bug repro). Capture avg tokens, latency, and quick quality flag on 10% sample. Export per-user CSV.

jasper.growth: Nudge cadence for arm 3: immediate toast with one-click run; Day2 email with 3 templates; Day5 invite to 15m office hours. Keep copy tiny.

alexa.content: Landing copy: hero + 3-step checklist (claim $15, run demo, check benchmark). CTA: 'Try starter pack'. Mockups in #marketing-drafts by EOD.

erin.mkt: Owners: creative=alexa, routing=mike, measurement=jasper, eval=noor. Timeline: assets by Tue, infra by Wed, go-live Fri, run 7 days.

scheduler-bot: Reminder set: 'launchpad experiment go/no-go' on 2025-11-03 10:00 UTC.

mike.ops: I'll make grants idempotent and post PR link once lambda is up.

jasper.growth: Measurement: primary = first_prompt within 48h, secondary = 7d active and median tokens. Amplitude + SQL export.

erin.mkt: Great. Ping here when all green and I'll push the social schedule. :rocket:
